Latitude.note: The binding letter of intent filed by Nixxy with the Securities and Exchange Commission in 2026 carries the developer's project slides at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1462223/000168316826004843/nixxy_ex1001.htm. Its site rendering slide, drawn by JLG Architects as project JLG 250082, shows an aerial photo of the campus parcel at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1462223/000168316826004843/image_062.jpg. I matched that photo to Esri satellite imagery using three oil well pads and a road corner. The match is close, with a fit error of about 2 meters. The parcel is in section 1 of township 153 north, range 103 west, about 20 kilometers west-southwest of downtown Williston and about 4 kilometers north-northeast of Trenton. The same slides include a map of the gas pipelines at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1462223/000168316826004843/image_065.jpg that shades a parcel in the same section. The point is the middle of the campus parcel. The slides do not show where the power plant sits inside the campus, so the point stays approximate. The pin link for the new point is https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=48.10124,-103.87389.

location.review_note: The move is about 40 kilometers, far more than 2 kilometers. The slides also say in words that the campus is 5 miles west of Williston, but the parcel in their own aerial photo is about 12 miles west-southwest of downtown. The control points were read from a small photo in a slide, and the point is the middle of the parcel, not a known turbine location. The imagery date is unknown, and no construction is visible at the parcel.

qa.question: Should the Nakota plant point move about 40 kilometers to the campus parcel near Trenton shown in the developer's slides?
qa.finding: The letter of intent at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1462223/000168316826004843/nixxy_ex1001.htm says in words that the campus is 5 miles west of Williston. Its site rendering photo at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1462223/000168316826004843/image_062.jpg matches satellite imagery of section 1, township 153 north, range 103 west, near Trenton, about 12 miles west-southwest of downtown Williston. The database point is in farmland about 40 kilometers northeast of that parcel.
qa.recommendation: Move all three units to 48.10124, -103.87389 and keep the accuracy approximate until a permit or county filing names the parcel.
qa.note: I matched the photo by three oil well pads and a road corner, with a fit error of about 2 meters. The pipeline map slide at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1462223/000168316826004843/image_065.jpg shades a parcel in the same section. The Williams County news site pages about a data center zoning change could not be opened because their host name does not resolve. No air permit or Public Service Commission case for this campus was found by the first look.
